validated_objective: Release QIF v0.6.39 with an executable, auditable, reversible adjudication-feedback-to-rubric-revision lifecycle.
scope: Extend calibration-report with feedback observations grounded in adjudication.
Represent exact rubric clauses, proposed wording, alternatives, dissent, impact, decisions, implementation, replay, rollback, and aggregate assessment.
Add deterministic verifier rules, example records, retained negative fixtures, plain-language docs, roadmap, and release evidence.
constraints: Do not build UI or external integrations.
Do not mutate rubrics automatically or retroactively rewrite historical decisions.
Do not infer truth, quality, competence, causality, or authority from feedback volume, agreement, acceptance rate, or score changes.
Do not use the records for employee surveillance or ranking.
expected_outcomes: A human or AI can trace a rubric revision from source disagreement through decision and implementation or rejection.
Rejected alternatives and dissent remain visible and rollback remains possible.
Structural validation remains explicitly separate from semantic validity.
